value: Record-level schema validity, one record per encountered dependency error. Denominators: original = notebooks processed in this run (comparable with pre-Round-2-explanation runs); round2 = newly reclassified Round-2 errors that received an explanation, INCLUDING non-repairable ones that exist in the trace only (not the repair-eligible, LLM-reached, or executed-round subset); combined = both. Retries are counted only in *_llm_attempts_incl_retries, never as extra records. A Round-2 explanation call is not a repair-agent invocation and does not enter any repair metric (table_1-table_6). These are automated schema checks only; the human explanation-quality study covered original-failure explanations exclusively.
